convert_volume_to_point_cloud: convert a 3D voxel volume array into a point cloud with optional BuGn colormap colors
convert_point_cloud_to_volume: convert a point cloud with colors or normals into a 4-channel voxel grid array
convert_strands_to_point_cloud: convert hair strand arrays into point clouds with random colors and tangent vectors
load_and_save_point_cloud: load a point cloud from file with colors or normals and save it back using Open3D
compute_point_cloud_bbox: compute the axis-aligned bounding box and center of a 3D point cloud array
